messages:
mira_release: Heads-up: found elevated latency and occasional tokenization errors after the routing change this morning. root cause appears to be fallback to legacy tokenizer when model variant lookup fails. Proposing hotfix: pin routing table for embeddings to v2-models for 30m while we patch lookup logic. Request quick approvals for expedited cut. @aj_ops @trina_oncall

deploybot: [automated] alert: routing mismatch detected -> initiating canary advisory. Canary nodes: 12, traffic mirror: 5%. See https://deploy.internal/routing/alerts/rt-2122

aj_ops: saw the same on infra metrics; p95 latency +120ms on embed path. Agree pinning routing is lowest-risk immediate fix. Need oncall +1 and a rollback knob.

trina_oncall: +1 from oncall. Will monitor tokenization error rate and SLOs for 20m after cut. Please include expected blast radius in release note.

lee_eng: patch ready: small change to lookup table in repo `infra/routing` PR#8123. Commands to pin: ``deploybot pin-route embeddings v2-models --expires 30m`` Will push to canary, validate, then promote. No model weights change.

mira_release: OK triggering canary pin now. Asking for ops green and oncall green to proceed to prod within 10m if canary stays healthy.

deploybot: action requested by mira_release at 7965433020: running `pin-route` in canary (5% traffic). health: tokenization errors -60% in canary, latencies down 80ms. logs: https://deploy.internal/logs/pin-8123

aj_ops: canary looks good. No downstream error spikes. +1 to promote.

hana_prodsec: tagging security for awareness: this change touches routing decisions but does not alter auth or keys. No security issues expected. FYI.

trina_oncall: promoting to 50% now, will hold 5m and then go to 100% if green. Watching for anomalies.

deploybot: promotion at 7965433045: 50% rollout in progress. health checks ok.

mira_release: drafting short release note for support: "Temporarily pinned embeddings routing to v2-models to mitigate intermittent tokenizer errors and latency caused by fallback to legacy variant. No model or data changes."

lee_eng: rollback plan: `deploybot unpin-route embeddings` (instant) -> restore dynamic lookup. If we see >1% tokenization errors or p95 spikes >200ms, rollback immediately. Steps in runbook: ```1) hit deploybot unpin-route 2) revert PR#8123 3) postmortem ticket link```

aj_ops: +1 applied, promoting to 100% now.

deploybot: [automated] rollout complete at 7965433061: routing pinned to v2-models for all embeddings traffic. expiration: 30m (auto unpin at 7965433241).

trina_oncall: initial telemetry: tokenization errors back to baseline and latency improved. I'll keep watch and update incident ticket.

mira_release: thanks team 1-1 expedited loop closed. Adding change note to release notes and attaching PR/rollback refs to the incident ticket.

hana_prodsec: acknowledged in case of audits. No further action required.
